description: Sizes a hot or cold water pipe, or a low-pressure gas pipe, and shows the working. Water: design flow (from outlets, with a simple in-use-at-once rule, or a flow you give), velocity against a limit (1.5 m/s default), pressure loss per metre and in total, and the pressure left at the outlet if you give the supply pressure. Gas: flow from the gross heat input of the appliances fed, pressure drop against the 1 mbar natural gas (2.5 mbar LPG) allowance, with a meter capacity warning. Returns `recommended` (smallest size that passes), `sizes_considered`, `must_check` (points the engineer confirms) and sources. Calculated from fluid physics (Darcy-Weisbach); no BS EN 806 or BS 6891 tables are reproduced. Typical calls: {"medium":"gas","heat_input_kw_gross":30,"run_length_m":12,"fittings":{"elbows":5}} or {"medium":"water","service":"cold","outlets":[{"type":"bath"},{"type":"kitchen_sink"},{"type":"basin"},{"type":"wc"},{"type":"shower_mixer"}],"run_length_m":15,"supply_pressure_bar":2.5,"height_rise_m":3}.

allowed_drop_mbar.description: Gas only. Default 1 natural gas, 2.5 LPG.

design_flow_l_s.description: Water only: design flow in litres a second, if known (overrides outlets).

fittings.description: Count of fittings on the run. If left out, 30% is added to the length instead (or fittings_allowance_percent).

bends.description: Swept or pulled bend, loss coefficient K 0.4.

tees_branch.description: Tee, flow into or out of the branch, loss coefficient K 1.5.

tees_through.description: Tee, flow straight through, loss coefficient K 0.4.

valves.description: Full-bore valve, open, loss coefficient K 0.3.

fittings_allowance_percent.description: Length added for fittings when they are not counted. Default 30.

gas_flow_m3_h.description: Gas only: gas flow, if already known.

heat_input_kw_gross.description: Gas only: total gross heat input of every appliance this pipe feeds (data plate).

heat_input_kw_net.description: Gas only: if only the net figure is known.

height_rise_m.description: Water only: height gained from start to outlet (negative if it falls).

material.description: Water: copper (default), plastic, mdpe. Gas: copper (default), steel, csst.

min_pressure_at_outlet_bar.description: Water only: pressure needed at the end. Default 1.0 bar.

outlets.description: Water only: outlets this pipe feeds.

run_length_m.description: Measured pipe length, metres (from the meter for gas, from the stop tap or cylinder for water).

simultaneous_outlets.description: Water only: how many outlets run at once. Default: square root of the number of outlets, rounded.

supply_pressure_bar.description: Water only: working pressure at the start of the run (measured with water flowing).

trade.description: Optional. The plumber or heating engineer's own business details (Nero Trade Profile v1, the same shape as Spark Pack and Nero Work). Used to prefill records and to give a stable nero_trade_ref. Not stored by Flow Pack.

categories.description: Trades offered, using Nero Work trade names. Defaults to ["plumber", "heating"].

company_name.description: Registered company name, if a limited company.

company_number.description: Companies House number, for example 12345678 or SC123456.

display_name.description: Trading name shown to customers, for example "Northside Plumbing & Heating".

licence_body.description: Registration scheme. For gas work use gas_safe with the business's Gas Safe registration number.

licence_number.description: Scheme registration number (Gas Safe registration numbers are usually 6 or 7 digits).
